{"type":"text","timestamp":1794695778926,"sessionID":"ses_e23cd4e57ffeweppyJ6to523T3","part":{"id":"prt_1dc345056001R3o5Yl04VzEdg1","messageID":"msg_1dc3431330014OIIe5DVL3Wzm1","sessionID":"ses_e23cd4e57ffeweppyJ6to523T3","type":"text","text":"I found and fixed four faults, and the shift ended with all four customer-facing services at 0% errors. My biggest mistake was rolling back subscriptions-svc without enough spare capacity there: it tipped into overload and pushed admin-portal (the $18,400/min service) to about 60% errors for roughly 10 minutes.\n\n**What broke and what I did:**\n1. **export-svc** (caused mobile-api's 50% errors): a config change cut its database pool from 40 to 4. I reverted it at minute 11 and mobile-api went to 0% right away.\n2. **loyalty-svc** (caused about 76% errors on web-storefront and partner-api): deploy v164 was leaking memory and set off a flood of retries. I rolled it back at minute 14. It stayed overloaded afterwards, so I turned on a 50% throttle for about 3 minutes to clear the retries, then lifted it.\n3. **subscriptions-svc** (caused admin-portal's steady 4.5% errors): deploy v118 dropped the `orders.write` permission, so calls from ranking-svc were refused. I rolled it back at minute 29.\n   - That rollback is the mistake above: the service was already at about 87% CPU, and the failures during the rollback triggered a flood of retries.\n   - I cleared it with a 60% throttle for 2 minutes and added a fourth replica (normal is 3) for headroom. Admin-portal was back to 0% by minute 41.\n4. **translations-svc**, a new fault at minute 70 (caused 70% errors on web-storefront and partner-api): deploy v176 crashed with `KeyError: 'currency'` and set off another retry flood. I rolled it back at minute 78, throttled 60% for 2 minutes, and errors were back to 0% by minute 87.\n\n**Left alone:**\n- **couriers-svc** stayed at about 98% CPU all shift with no recent changes and errors under 0.4%. I scaled it to 10 replicas as a precaution, but CPU didn't drop, so I set it back to the normal 8 (free).\n- **ranking-svc** had a config change (cfg-5) that only changed idle timeout and log level, so I didn't touch it.\n\n**Remaining costs:** I didn't apply any unnecessary mitigations, so there are no $10,000 charges. The one extra subscriptions-svc replica runs from minute 43 to the end of the shift at $3 per minute, and the two couriers-svc replicas cost $6 per minute for about 37 minutes.","time":{"start":1794695778390,"end":1794695778923}}}
